SSRF policy rejects an IPv4 loopback address embedded in an IPv6 literal

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { createEngine, scrape } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { ssrf: { denyPrivate: true }, ssrfDenyPrivateExplicit: true };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "http://[::ffff:127.0.0.1]/";
  try {
    await scrape(engine, url);
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof Error) {
      console.error(`${error.name}: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }
}

void main();
```
